Overview

SaaS Development, explained

If you've spotted a problem that other businesses share, a software-as-a-service product can turn your know-how into recurring revenue. Building one properly takes more than an app: it needs accounts for many customers, billing, permissions and reliable hosting.

We design and build multi-tenant SaaS platforms from first version to launch and beyond. You own the product and its code, and we can keep developing and hosting it as it grows.

Who it's for

  • Founders with a software product idea
  • Businesses turning an internal tool into a product
  • Companies replacing a spreadsheet-based service
  • Teams that need a reliable development partner

Why it matters

Why SaaS Development matters for your business

Software-as-a-service turns a solution into recurring revenue. If other businesses share the problem you've solved, a subscription product can reach them anywhere in the world.

But a SaaS product has to do far more than a single-company app. Each customer's data must stay separate and secure, billing must be reliable, and the platform must stay fast as you add customers.

We bring the technical team you need to design, build and launch it properly, while you keep ownership of the product and its code.

Pricing

What affects the cost of SaaS Development

  • How many parts of your business the system covers (for example sales, jobs, stock and staff)
  • How many existing tools, files or databases we need to connect or migrate
  • Number of user types and the permissions each needs
  • Whether you need a mobile app, a customer portal, or both
  • Hosting, support and new features after launch (optional)

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

Get a fixed quote

Getting started

What we'll need from you

  • A list of the apps and subscriptions you pay for today
  • A rough picture of how work moves through your business, from enquiry to invoice
  • Examples of the reports, forms and documents you use
  • Someone on your team who can answer questions and test as we build

Don't have all of this yet? That's fine. We'll work through it together in your free consultation.

FAQ

SaaS Development questions

Can you start with a smaller first version?

Yes. We usually launch a focused first version, then add features based on what your customers use.

Do you host the platform?

Yes. We can host, maintain and keep developing the platform for you, and you still own it.

Do we need a technical co-founder?

No. We act as your technical team, and you keep ownership of the product.

Can you help us decide what to build first?

Yes. We help you pick the smallest version that proves the idea to paying customers.

Will we own the code?

Yes. The product and its source code belong to your business.

Can you help with pricing plans?

We can set up the plan structures you choose, including trials, tiers and add-ons.

Do you offer ongoing development?

Yes. Most SaaS products keep evolving, and we can stay on as your development team.

Can our product integrate with other tools?

Yes. We can build APIs and integrations so customers can connect your product to their systems.
